title: Ryan Poles: Rule giving picks to teams that develop minority coaches and GMs is "strange"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ryan Poles: Rule giving picks to teams that develop minority coaches and GMs is "strange"
sources.description: When Ryan Poles left the Chiefs to become the Bears' General Manager in 2022, the Chiefs got two third-round compensatory picks because Poles is Black and the NFL rewards teams that develop minority head coaches and GMs.
